question: Rajagriha was the first capital of which Mahajanapada?
solution:
The correct answer is Magadha. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajagriha **was the first capital of **Magadha Mahajanapada.**
 
• Magadha was located in **present-day Bihar** and was one of the **sixteen Mahajanapadas** (great kingdoms) of ancient India.
